run_detail.final_report_markdown:
# 为 JavaScript 项目引入 TypeScript 是否降低了线上缺陷率？比较不同研究的结论。

以下报告仅综合已通过核验的研究结论，并为每项事实保留可回溯的证据引用。

## GitHub security/quality analyses of typed vs untyped JavaScript · Methodology and dataset

We conducted a large-scale correlation anal-ysis involving more than 4,000 real-world TypeScript repositories [evidence:32ccd02094084cb0e72345126e9d784490b942f8058b967d] [evidence:69ea7591caf9c3d1d081aaf2338629d828dea61792e5da95] [evidence:6255878393be44db7f6f4ac387b91d501028ca0459429272]

## GitHub security/quality analyses of typed vs untyped JavaScript · Quantified defect outcome

一项分析600多个GitHub仓库的2022年研究发现，TypeScript似乎并未在缺陷方面带来显著差异 [evidence:2daf3633329b1b6c4996991ac6fc303e74090d548530051b] [evidence:6dec5c1fa16a67f036f39b753b66cca9b25c4853047c631a]

## GitHub security/quality analyses of typed vs untyped JavaScript · Study conclusion on defect rate

TypeScript 应用与更少 bug 无显著关系，bug 倾向和 bug 修复时间反而 JavaScript 项目更低 [evidence:9802dc99a4421745a29784bd7f09b6acf06257179155b303] [evidence:1499a1250691c94a4930aac7fe3392207c1c9869b02755bf]

## GitHub security/quality analyses of typed vs untyped JavaScript · Confounders and limitations

Flow 与 TypeScript 可检测的缺陷大量重叠，仅6个例外，说明类型系统差异会影响比较结果 [evidence:1e86f2cadf0f9afd0becf61ce334fe6868562af8e7110563] [evidence:769968378847172ab6e0a4ff08ea2d7399403fd1fc86e5c8]

## Microsoft TypeScript adoption experience reports · Methodology and dataset

研究挖掘了16个以TypeScript为主的GitHub仓库中的633条缺陷相关commit、issue和PR [evidence:08838c6aad4647bdc07ab9313b2cb516f0dd9a72f70e8ebe]

## Microsoft TypeScript adoption experience reports · Study conclusion on defect rate

TypeScript 静态类型能防止许多局部错误，但将故障重心从逻辑转向编排 [evidence:a4ce4fb4f7435aeaea094a17a421e78fb2cf1de5f3bc0728]

## Microsoft TypeScript adoption experience reports · Confounders and limitations

仅一个项目是 Angular 2 + TypeScript 与 Angular 1 + JavaScript 对比，其余为 React/Node 项目，对比基础有限。 [evidence:582f2a3a7422816e35f691977d0868f4b0715b0095296715] [evidence:18e899d04be8e5d8638e88ece8cf6d6b3cc6350c142c1c9f]

## Bogner & Merkel TypeScript code quality longitudinal study · Study conclusion on defect rate

研究表明，与流行看法相反，TypeScript 与更少的缺陷并无显著关系。 [evidence:16e71581660724313554b4f9a77e440d8bb9f082f3c521f4] [evidence:577bff0e53acbd569d8178749b3c6296ddbe22641f2de14c]

## Merkel et al. TypeScript software quality study · Methodology and dataset

其研究方法属于挖掘软件仓库的实证研究 [evidence:ec2b0b9705d8280c7204d0e18f8b93e05a037dfd77892884]

## Merkel et al. TypeScript software quality study · Quantified defect outcome

在 JavaScript 与 TypeScript 应用直接比较中，TypeScript 与更少缺陷无显著关联 [evidence:d9386863a68376fad3afb297f9b13bc0e8432c9135053720]

## 局限

- Microsoft TypeScript adoption experience reports · Quantified defect outcome：必需研究项未找到足够证据
- Bogner & Merkel TypeScript code quality longitudinal study · Methodology and dataset：必需研究项未找到足够证据
